generationMethod: Built-in image_gen; generated PNGs converted to repository WebP. Environments 1280x854 at quality 88; character cutouts 768x1152 at quality 90.
referencePeriod: Original World of Warcraft: Wrath of the Lich King patch 3.3.5a; excludes Cataclysm city states.
interpretationPolicy: Generated fan art is not canonical game art, exact quest screenshots, surveyed geography, or floor plans. Story-theater anchors are relational and do not prove co-presence.
areaComparison: Human comparison with matching 3.3.5a client remains open. Stormwind Keep is pale/white stone with blue-and-gold heraldry; Orgrimmar is red sandstone, timber, and iron; Undercity is shadowed Forsaken stone, pipes, and green-purple light; Dragonblight and Angrathar use frozen northern terrain and massive ruined architecture.
